title: Best Identity Theft Protection 2026: 5 services compared on monitoring and recovery
description: LifeLock, Aura, IdentityForce, IDShield, Experian — monthly cost, reimbursement caps, 3-bureau monitoring, and family plan coverage compared.
lede: Five ID theft protection services tested for 90 days. We submitted a fake breach alert to each and tracked detection time + recovery support quality.
methodology: Subscribed to each at family/premium tier. Submitted a controlled dark-web alert (fake data) and tracked detection time. Called recovery hotline at 3 times of day. Measured tools: monitoring scope, restoration help, reimbursement.

sections.heading: Coverage and recovery support
paragraphs: LifeLock Ultimate Plus: $30/mo, $3M reimbursement, includes Norton 360. Aura Family: $30/mo for 5 family members, $5M cap. IDShield: $33/mo family, includes PI consultation.

IdentityForce: $24/mo, $1M reimbursement (lower cap). Experian IdentityWorks: $25/mo, $1M reimbursement, includes FICO score updates. Aura's family plan wins on coverage-per-dollar; LifeLock wins on Norton bundle.

faqs.a: Yes if you have $50K+ assets, multiple credit accounts, or experienced a breach. The annual cost ($360) is less than the median time-cost of recovering from theft (200+ hours). For lower-risk: free credit freezes are 80% of the protection.
Family plan if 2+ adults need coverage — saves 30-40% vs individual plans. Aura's family plan ($30/mo for 5) is the best per-person ($6/person).

lifelock-ultimate-plus.review: Best monitoring + tools bundle. $30/mo includes Norton 360 with VPN, 3M reimbursement. Social media monitoring is unique.

aura-id-protection-family.review: Best family plan. $30/mo for 5 family members ($6/person), $5M reimbursement, VPN + password manager + antivirus included.

identityforce-ultrasecure.review: $24/mo, $1M reimbursement, 3-bureau credit + bank takeover monitoring. Lower reimbursement cap than competitors.

idshield-3bureau-family.review: $33/mo family, includes licensed PI consultation (rare). Best for victims of repeat fraud or stalking.

experian-identityworks-premium.review: $25/mo, Experian FICO score updates. Best if you're focused on credit health, not just fraud monitoring.

pinDescription: 5 identity theft protection services tested 90 days. LifeLock vs Aura vs IdentityForce vs IDShield vs Experian. Family plans, reimbursement caps. #identitytheft #fraudprotection
